description: How the server's tick copes with a fight. From the starter world's Tristan, undock, measure 15 s of ticks as a baseline, then spawn 20 NPCs that fight each other with stock /npctest2 and measure 60 s of the fight. Booted with the tick profiler, so the report breaks each tick down by subsystem.

setup.note: the baseline: one ship on grid
20 NPCs in a free-for-all; /npc 20 would spawn 20 that attack the ship instead

expect.note: the watch read the server's ticks
the tick profiler broke them down by subsystem
no 5 s window has 5 of its 50 ticks over the 100 ms a tick has; on stock the fight puts the odd one over
